units.source_text: 傍晚时分，侍女们报道：“今晚从禁中到此间，中神当道，方向不利[\[23\]](#part1331.html#m23)。”

en.t: Toward evening, the ladies-in-waiting reported, "Tonight, from the palace to this place, the Middle Deity blocks the way, so the direction is unlucky."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“怪不得，宫中也常常回避这方向。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "No wonder; at court they often avoid this direction too.

units.source_text: 我那二条院也在这个方向。

en.t: My Nijo residence also lies in that direction.

units.source_text: 教我到哪里去回避才好呢？

en.t: Where am I supposed to go to avoid it?

units.source_text: 真是恼人啊！”

en.t: How vexing this is!"

units.source_text: 他就躺下来想睡了。

en.t: Then he lay down and tried to sleep.

units.source_text: 侍女们齐声说：“这可不行！”

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting all cried together, "That will not do!"

units.source_text: 有人报道：“侍臣中有一个亲随，是纪伊的国守，他家住在中川边上，最近开辟池塘，导入川水，屋里很凉爽呢。”

en.t: Someone reported, "Among the attendants there is a close retainer who is the governor of Kii. His house stands beside the Nakagawa, and lately he has dug a pond and led in river water, so it is very cool inside."

units.source_text: 公子说：“那好极了。

en.t: The prince said, "That is excellent.

units.source_text: 我心里懊恼，懒得多走，最好是牛车进得去的地方……”

en.t: I feel out of sorts and cannot be bothered to go far; somewhere a carriage can enter would be best..."

units.source_text: 其实，他有许多恋人，今宵要回避中神，尽有地方可去。

en.t: In truth, he had many lovers, and if he had to avoid the Middle Deity tonight, there were plenty of places he could go.

units.source_text: 只恐葵姬想：你久不来此，今天故意选取回避中神的日子，一到就转赴别处——这倒是对她不起的。

en.t: But he feared Lady Aoi might think, after staying away so long, he had deliberately chosen a day for avoiding the Middle Deity and, as soon as he arrived, gone off somewhere else; that would be unfair to her.

units.source_text: 他就对纪伊守说知，要到他家去避凶。

en.t: So he informed the governor of Kii that he would go to his house to avoid the ill omen.

units.source_text: 纪伊守立刻遵命。

en.t: The governor of Kii immediately obeyed.

units.source_text: 但他退下来对旁的人说：“我父亲伊豫介家里最近举行斋戒，女眷都寄居我家，屋里狭窄嘈杂，生怕得罪了公子呢。”

en.t: But after withdrawing, he said to the people nearby, "My father, the Iyo vice-governor, has recently been observing ritual abstinence at his house, so all the women have been staying at mine. The house is cramped and noisy, and I fear it may offend the prince."

units.source_text: 说着很担心。

en.t: He sounded very worried as he said this.

units.source_text: 但源氏公子已经听到了这话，他说：“人多的地方最好呢。

en.t: But Prince Genji had already heard his words and said, "A place with many people is best.

units.source_text: 在没有女人的屋子里宿夜，心里有些害怕似的。

en.t: Spending the night in a house with no women in it feels rather frightening.

units.source_text: 我只要在她们的帷屏后面过夜就行了。”

en.t: It will be enough for me to pass the night behind their curtains and screens."

units.source_text: 大家都笑道：“那么，这地方真是最好的宿处了。”

en.t: Everyone laughed and said, "In that case, this place truly is the best lodging."

units.source_text: 便派人去通知纪伊守家里。

en.t: So they sent someone to inform the governor of Kii's household.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心中想道：不要大肆声张，悄悄地走吧。

en.t: Prince Genji thought to himself: let us make no fuss and go quietly.

units.source_text: 便匆促动身，连左大臣那里也没有告辞，只带几个亲近的随从。

en.t: Then he set out in haste, without even taking leave of the Minister of the Left, bringing only a few close attendants with him.
